test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select ‘No error’. '**

The Federalists wished to/ make the central government/ as strong possible.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: "**as strong possible**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase "**as strong as possible**" is a correct comparative construction, but it requires the word "**as**" before "possible."
 
• The correct sentence should be "*The Federalists wished to make the central government as strong as possible.*" 
 
• The error in Option 1 is the missing word "**as**," which makes the sentence ungrammatical.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.
